responsibility: Documents the preprocessor options that control header search paths and system include classification. It explains the semantics and search-order effects of options such as @option{-I}, @option{-iquote}, @option{-isystem}, @option{-idirafter}, @option{-iprefix}, @option{-iwithprefix}, @option{-isysroot}, and the @option{-nostdinc} variants, and is written for inclusion in both the GCC and CPP manuals.
